title: Implement WOLFKM-3dh hygiene decisions in crypto2dev_ioctl.h
description: Apply three decided changes to include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h: (a) change magic byte to \xC2, (b) remove tombstone comment on slots 6-7, (c) add comment near exportable fields explaining it is a boolean parameter not a bitmask flag.
close_reason: Magic byte changed to \xC2 (all ioctl defs now use macro); tombstone comment replaced with 'available for future assignment'; no-flags exception documented in file header.
